title: Jim Martin's fate and his wife, once part of the Glover and Nettie Compton show
summary: They try to recall Jim Martin's wife's earlier name; she had come along with Glover and Nettie and Nettie could say.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What's happened to Jim Martin? Do you know?
Oh, he retired, you know. He rented his place out.
Well, his place is gone now. Well, she was over there the other night, you know, his wife.
Didn't see his wife. Oh, to his back. No, well, I didn't know her as... Oh, yeah. I may have met her, but I didn't know her as Jim Martin's wife. Um...
She was one of the old-timers, you know, like, old-time entertainers, like, uh...
Like, uh... Let me see... What's... Oh, my goodness, wasn't that woman's first name.
No, her name wasn't Martin at that time.

See, she came along with Glover and Nettie. Oh, yeah. You know, and she was in the show, show along with them, see. Oh. But, uh... Her name wasn't Martin at that time. Yeah. It was another name. Charlotte was just about to know, but I forgot.
